meta.parties: John Singho v. Beet An Singo Et Al

rules.statement: A tenant can obstruct the execution of a decree for possession, and if such obstruction is at the instigation of the judgment-debtor, the person obstructing (even if ostensible) may be held liable under sections 325 and 326 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held , that the third respondent was liable to be punished under the provisions of sections 325 and 326 of the Civil Procedure Code."
